deadline.value: December 1, 2026 (applications open October 1, 2026); FAQ says later applications are often still considered
deadline.quote: Applications for the PhD Program Open October 1, 2026 | Due date for applications: December 1, 2026

also.quote: we try to remain flexible about these deadlines and will often consider applications which arrive later.

gre_subject.quote: Both the GRE General Test and the GRE Physics Test are optional.

supervisor.value: Admission is department-wide, not tied to a research group; contacting faculty is not needed to gain admission
supervisor.quote: Admissions decisions are made for our department as a whole, and are not specifically connected to any particular research group. | while you are always free to contact individual faculty members about their research interests and opportunities, you should not feel compelled to do so in order to gain admission to our program.

funding.value: All admitted PhD students guaranteed TA or RA funding for at least the first two years; department strives to continue it with satisfactory progress
funding.quote: All students admitted to our Ph.D. program are guaranteed funding at least for the first two years, either in the form of a Teaching Assistantship (TA) or a Research Assistantship (RA).

entry_route.value: Not stated on the pages checked (Graduate College minimum for India: 3-year bachelor showing 120+ credits)

app_fee.value: USD 90 non-refundable processing fee for all applicants
app_fee.quote: A $90 non-refundable processing fee is required for all applications.

fee_waiver.value: Waivers for participants of listed sponsored programs (mostly U.S. schemes such as McNair, TRIO, GEM; list also includes Latin American summer/winter research programs) and need-based waivers on request to the program coordinator with evidence such as U.S. federal grants (Pell); no explicit statement on international eligibility
fee_waiver.quote: If you are a participant of one of the sponsored programs in this link, you may be eligible for a fee waiver by submitting a verification letter. | To inquire about need-based application fee waiver, contact the graduate program coordinator with evidence such as previously received need-based federal grants (for example Pell grants).

also.quote: This webform is utilized to submit a verification letter to confirm the participation of an applicant in one of the sponsored programs that is approved for an application fee waiver.

gre_general.value: Optional; scheduled test dates may be listed
gre_general.quote: Both the GRE General Test and the GRE Physics Test are optional.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 7 minimum, per the physics FAQ.
ielts_min.quote: The minimum acceptable IELTS score is 7.

notes: Graduate College country table lists the minimum degree for India as a 3-year bachelor showing 120 or more credits. Duolingo is not accepted.
